title.en: vintage market at the merrick house.

line.en: vintage dealers and independent makers in the garden of the merrick family house: housewares, furniture, clothes and collectibles. admission listed as free, 10 am to 4 pm.
line.de: vintage-händler und kleine hersteller im garten des merrick-hauses: haushalt, möbel, kleidung und sammlerstücke. eintritt laut angabe frei, 10 bis 16 uhr.
line.tr: merrick ailesinin evinin bahçesinde vintage satıcılar ve bağımsız üreticiler: ev eşyası, mobilya, giyim ve koleksiyon parçaları. giriş ilana göre ücretsiz, 10:00-16:00.
